top_signals.title: China-US Spat at G20 Largely Came Down to Dispute Over One Word
top_signals.summary: A disagreement between Chinese and US officials at a Group of 20 finance chiefs meeting this week mostly revolved around a dispute over one word, according to people familiar with the talks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: ‘Stratospheric’ $127 Billion From India’s Diaspora to Aid Rupee
top_signals.summary: India drew a record $127 billion from its vast diaspora through special programs, far surpassing estimates and giving policymakers a formidable buffer to defend the beleaguered rupee.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Dogecoin becomes only losing bet for Japan-listed firm as it sells altcoins for bitcoin
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Yen rallies after Bessent’s Abenomics comment
top_signals.summary: Japan's currency is back below ¥158 to the dollar for the first time since early August.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Court halts Trump’s new birthright citizenship curbs
top_signals.summary: The fresh setback to U.S. President Donald Trump's hard-line immigration agenda puts the fight over birthright citizenship on a path to return to the Supreme Court.
